answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation is an important and challenging task in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP)...

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the fidelity automatically, we use BertScore , which has been widely used to evaluate semantic similarity . To evaluate the diversity automatically, we calculate "Self-BLEU", i.e., the BLEU-4 score between the output and input sentences.

answer_4.quote: we also conduct the human evaluation to evaluate the quality of generated paraphrases of each model. Concretely, we randomly sample 100 test instances from Parabank and 100 test instances from Quora datasets, and ask volunteers to score the outputs from the following aspects: (1) Fidelity, (2) Diversity, and (3) Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: volunteers to score the outputs from the following aspects: (1) Fidelity, (2) Diversity, and (3) Fluency.
